```{=html}
<style>

```

::: {.action-phase-equations}
$$
Q(t)=A\cos\theta,
\qquad
P(t)=-m\omega A\sin\theta,
\qquad
\theta=\omega t.
$$
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.actionPhaseReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.actionPhaseReady = "true";

    const spaceDot = root.querySelector("[data-space-dot]");
    const spaceVector = root.querySelector("[data-space-vector]");
    const spaceQ = root.querySelector("[data-space-q]");
    const phaseDot = root.querySelector("[data-phase-dot]");
    const phaseVector = root.querySelector("[data-phase-vector]");
    const qGuide = root.querySelector("[data-phase-q-guide]");
    const pGuide = root.querySelector("[data-phase-p-guide]");
    const start = performance.now();

    function draw(now) {
      if (!document.body.contains(root)) return;

      const slide = root.closest("section");
      if (!slide || slide.classList.contains("present")) {
        const theta = 1.15 * (now - start) / 1000;
        const q = Math.cos(theta);
        const p = -Math.sin(theta);

        const spaceX = 280 + 175 * q;
        spaceDot.setAttribute("cx", spaceX.toFixed(2));
        spaceVector.setAttribute("x2", spaceX.toFixed(2));
        spaceQ.setAttribute("x", (spaceX + (q >= 0 ? 13 : -30)).toFixed(2));

        const phaseX = 280 + 175 * q;
        const phaseY = 150 - 105 * p;
        phaseDot.setAttribute("cx", phaseX.toFixed(2));
        phaseDot.setAttribute("cy", phaseY.toFixed(2));
        phaseVector.setAttribute("x2", phaseX.toFixed(2));
        phaseVector.setAttribute("y2", phaseY.toFixed(2));
        qGuide.setAttribute("x1", phaseX.toFixed(2));
        qGuide.setAttribute("x2", phaseX.toFixed(2));
        qGuide.setAttribute("y1", phaseY.toFixed(2));
        qGuide.setAttribute("y2", "150");
        pGuide.setAttribute("x1", "280");
        pGuide.setAttribute("x2", phaseX.toFixed(2));
        pGuide.setAttribute("y1", phaseY.toFixed(2));
        pGuide.setAttribute("y2", phaseY.toFixed(2));
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-action-phase-demo]").forEach(initialize);
  }

  initializeAll();
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeAll, {once: true});
})();
</script>
```
